paper.title: Cellular adhesome screen identifies critical modulators of focal adhesion dynamics, cellular traction forces and cell migration behaviour

declarations.competing_interests: Not stated in the converted text.

definitions.definition: MCF7 human breast adenocarcinoma cells (from ATCC) stably overexpressing the IGF1 receptor, with lentiviral mCherry-LifeAct for live imaging.

Knockdown of 569 adhesion-related genes with Dharmacon SMARTpool siRNAs (four siRNAs per gene, 50 nM, DharmaFECT 4), followed by a nocodazole wash-out focal adhesion assay imaged by automated confocal microscopy; duplicate wells, 5-8 images per well.

Area of focal adhesions stained for phospho-Tyr118 paxillin or vinculin, segmented from confocal images; distributions compared with the mock-transfected control by a two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test.
Speed of single MCF7-IGF1R cells in random migration after IGF1 stimulation, from live-cell tracking.
Force exerted by cells on elastomeric micropillar arrays, and its turnover (autocorrelation half-time).
Knockdown of TPM1, PPP1R12B, RAC2 and HIPK3, each by SMARTpool and by single siRNAs.
siRNA knockdown of protein phosphatase 1 regulatory subunit 12B.
siRNA knockdown of the small GTPase RAC2.
siRNA knockdown of homeodomain-interacting protein kinase 3.
The four candidate knockdowns and the mock control, as compared in the force experiments.
Transfection reagent without siRNA; with siGFP and non-targeting siRNA the negative controls.

claims.statement: Of the [[D2:adhesome siRNA screen]]'s 569 genes, 30 increased and 11 decreased [[D3:focal adhesion size]] in [[D1:MCF7-IGF1R cells]] when knocked down.
Knockdown of each of the [[D6:candidate genes]] enlarged focal adhesions and reduced [[D4:IGF1-induced migration speed]] of [[D1:MCF7-IGF1R cells]] compared with [[D11:mock transfection]].

Compared with [[D11:mock transfection]], three of the [[D6:candidate genes]] ([[D8:PPP1R12B knockdown]], [[D10:HIPK3 knockdown]] and [[D9:RAC2 knockdown]]) increased [[D5:traction force]] and slowed its turnover in [[D1:MCF7-IGF1R cells]].

evidence.description: Primary siRNA screen of 569 adhesion genes: focal adhesion size after nocodazole wash-out, per knockdown against mock.

results.variable: genes whose knockdown increased focal adhesion size (D > 0.1, p < 1e-40)
genes whose knockdown decreased focal adhesion size (D < -0.075, p < 1e-25)

evidence.description: Random migration of IGF1-stimulated MCF7-IGF1R cells after SMARTpool knockdown of all 64 primary hits, then single siRNAs for the consistent ones; Kruskal-Wallis with Dunn's post-test, experiments in duplicate, significant only if p < 0.05 in every experiment.

results.variable: primary hits whose SMARTpool knockdown reduced migration consistently
genes whose knockdown reduced migration with two or more single siRNAs

evidence.description: Traction force microscopy on micropillar arrays after knockdown of the four candidates; four independent experiments, each knockdown in two; unpaired t-tests with Welch's correction.

tables.description: Cells analysed and force turnover half-time per knockdown
columns: force autocorrelation half-time relative to mock

limitations.statement: Hits were called on distribution shifts with fixed D and p thresholds over thousands of adhesions per well, so a call reflects image counts more than the number of independent experiments.
Force and migration results rest on two independent experiments per knockdown and 7 to 23 cells per condition.
